indicators.indicator: Illustrative AI workload as a share of a monthly minimum wage
indicators.source: Computed from Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic) rate card and the statutory minimum wage
indicators.tier_label: Derived from academic and official inputs
indicators.methodology: A month of moderate use = 20 standard workloads at the median frontier rate card ($11.25 per workload), divided by the monthly statutory minimum wage.

indicators.indicator: Illustrative AI-use basket as a share of monthly GNI per capita
indicators.source: Computed from Claude Opus 5 rate card and World Bank GNI per-capita data
indicators.tier_label: Derived from reported pricing and official economic data
indicators.methodology: 20 standard workloads at the median frontier rate card ($11.25 per workload), divided by monthly GNI per capita on the Atlas method (annual value divided by 12). Published only when the latest non-empty GNI observation is within the five-calendar-year freshness window.
indicators.note: GNI per capita is a national-average economic indicator, not median earnings, household disposable income, or a typical worker's wage. The baseline rate card is trade-reported, so this derived comparison is not headline eligible.
